ownerTreeDefinition: Admission guard plus all transitive descendants, including awake guard, controller and sampler; retain known same-lifetime reparented descendants. Sum of resident bytes at each validated snapshot, including repeated shared pages.
samplingLimit: 50ms sampled, non-atomic per-process reads; shorter lived processes or intersample peaks are not guaranteed. Any failed/truncated/unattributed sample refuses the owner-tree conclusion.
